correctness.rationale: On the generic two-node Prony stratum, the first three selected even-index moments give nonsingular conic S²=Q(P) with Δ=s2²-s0s4≠0. Recurrence reduces even moments to polynomial E_{2k}(P) of degree 2k−4 and odd moments to N_{2k+1}(P)/S with degree numerator 2k−2. Even targets compose the degree-two conic projection with polynomial degree n−5; odd targets eliminate S giving degree 2n−8 and a unique generic lift, separable over C. Nonzero leading coefficients were independently checked using sympy for n=6..26; finite tests support rather than replace induction.
